base: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished high fidelity WEBSITE UI MOCKUP image for کانون آشتیانی, an Iranian gifted education academy in Torbat Heydarieh for students grades four through ten and parents. This is a full-bleed flat website screenshot, not a device mockup, no perspective, no browser chrome, no external presentation title. Persian RTL layout, excellent connected Persian typesetting resembling Vazirmatn, short readable exact supplied Persian headings. Long prose may use neat gray skeleton lines rather than garbled text. Modern warm trustworthy editorial educational design, generous spacing, strong hierarchy, varied layouts, soft 18px corner radii, subtle borders, NO heavy shadows, no gradients. Palette navy #1f2b4d, orange #f08a1c, white, offwhite #f4f6fb, small blue #2b5fa8 and green #1f8a5b. Orange buttons use dark navy text for contrast. All illustrations flat geometric vector-like with simple faces, girls in simple headscarves and long modest clothes, boys casual. No photographs, no mosque/dome illustration, no neon, no foreign brands, no bank details, no invented statistics or testimonials. Use supplied reference image ONLY as the official small brand logo in header/footer: teal outline of Iran with sprouting pencil, graduation cap and green/red ribbons, NO calligraphy underneath. Keep its colors; do not replace with star-book logo. Logo at far RIGHT, nav to its left, action buttons at far LEFT. Consistent design system across all screens. Render only requested section/page, not unrelated sections.

assets.note: متن اصلی در راست و تصویرسازی در چپ قرار دارد؛ دکمهٔ نارنجی و سه نکتهٔ کوتاه مسیر تصمیم والدین را روشن می‌کنند.
